buildCommand: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && (cd python && uv sync --extra docs) && uv run --project python mkdocs build --strict --config-file mkdocs.yml && pnpm docs:typedoc && pnpm docs:build
ignoreCommand: git diff HEAD^ HEAD --quiet -- docs docs-python ts/src python/src typedoc.json mkdocs.yml docs/.vitepress vercel.json
